source_diagnosis.product_section: Billing address uses the shared Collapsible and exposes aria-expanded, aria-hidden, and inert states. Its inner card is conditional on billing_same_as_shipping; the section has a 200 ms grid-height transition.
source_diagnosis.driver_defect: The Profile expander helper sampled one center point after scrollIntoView and sent a trusted mouse event at that point without rechecking movement. The shared pointer driver already waits for a stable, hit-tested point after animation. A section moving between sample and dispatch can miss the click and leave the expected expanded state false.
source_diagnosis.native_causality_limit: The native report retained phase and section but not the underlying assertion or pointer trace. It cannot distinguish a missed click, a post-click state mismatch, or a product failure. Native rerun is required to establish whether this repair resolves the observed failure.

repair: Profile expander toggles now use the shared trusted click(panel, 'section', name) path. The existing post-click expanded/hidden/inert assertions remain.

guard.red_before_repair: Billing reexpand test failed with billing_reexpand_did_not_change because the one-shot pointer dispatched at the stale point.
guard.green_after_repair: Five tests passed. The connected Billing guard drives the actual toggle source and shared pointer driver with a moving target, then observes a trusted click only at the stable position.

existing_row_prerequisite: The native admin setup had profile_row_existed_before=true. profile-native-acceptance.mjs creates ownedJournal only for an absent row created and owned by the run. With this existing row, T06 and T18 field-write cases are recorded unverified with reason preexisting_row_lacks_durable_conditional_full_field_restoration. This repair does not bypass that write authority requirement.
scope_limits: Source-only repair and focused tests; no browser rerun, build, release, database or authentication mutation.
